summary: James Orr is a Cambridge philosopher of religion and UK chairman of the Edmund Burke Foundation, which organizes NatCon in Britain. A friend of JD Vance since 2019, who has called him his "British sherpa", he became a senior adviser to Nigel Farage in 2025 and Reform UK's head of policy in February 2026. He stepped down on September 4, 2026, pending a party investigation, after a Channel 4 undercover sting on foreign donations; Reform denied wrongdoing.
